Ohaidere. tl;dr at the end for you lazy types.

 

I'm the nerd running the Steam discussion on the unlock. Just noticed my account was approved, haha.

 

Anyway, thought I'd come and share some of the information from over there.

 

We're currently toying with the idea of a three game requirement, first against standard Omnitron, then against Omnitron-II, and then against whoever.

First game info:

We really don't know if it even is needed, but several players have commented about not getting the unlock until they faced off against standard Omnitron before doing a game against Cosmitron. I had toyed with the assumption that Slip Through Time was a required play during this game, but a player who unlocked Unitron (who admittedly could not share their game logs) commented that they did not use either Slip Through Time or Self Sabotage during this game, so it may be as simple as having Omnitron-X and/or Unity in this game.

Second game info:

Again, most people have not been sharing their logs of this game either, so it's all been speculation at best. However, there's a general consensus that Omnitron-X and Unity must be in the game, Omnitron-X must use at least Self Sabotage (and possibly Slip Through Time), and that he must be the only incapacitated hero at the end.

Third game info:

This one we more or less have hashed out. The general idea for this game is that Unity must be on the team, and Omnitron-X and Tachyon must not be on the team. Unity must have one of each of Modular Workbench, Volatile Parts, Scrap Metal, and possibly Construction Pylon IN PLAY (not just played and trashed) at the end of the game, and that Unity must play Robot Reclamation at least once. We also haven't seen a game where Unity has drawn less than 25 cards, so that may also be a factor.

 

Things that definitely don't matter:

Unity or her bots do not need to deal the final blow.

The heroes do not need to be at low health.

Having every kind of bot in play is not needed.

Doing anything special with Volatile Parts is not needed.

Recalling bots with Scrap Metal is not needed.

Playing any other one-shot than Robot Reclamation is not needed.

The villain and environment don't matter.

 

TL;DR version:

Not the exact condition (unless a minor edit makes me guess right), but this has helped people out.

First, defeat Omnitron with Omnitron-X and Unity on the team. Second, defeat Omnitron-II with Omnitron-X and Unity on the team. Omnitron-X must play Self Sabotage (and Slip Through Time?) at least once. Omnitron-X must be the only incapacitated hero. Then, defeat any villain in any environment with Unity and without Omnitron-X or Tachyon on the team. Unity must play Robot Reclamation at least once and end the game with at least one copy of Modular Workbench, Volatile Parts, (Construction Pylon?) and Scrap Metal in play.

 

Happy hunting, folks.

S'me again.

 

More info for the peoples who don't go to the Steam discussion.

 

Did some research on a pair of Cosmitron games, one my own and one from a pair of games that led to a successful unlock, and I turned up some interesting statistics. That said, we don't have many successful Cosmitron games to look through, so this information, while useful, is not from a large sample size.

 

-In both games, Omni-X died while at least one of each of his components were in the trash.

-In both games, one of each of all of Cosmitron's cards were in his trash.

-In one game, Self Sabotage destroyed one Omni-X component, while in the other, it destroyed 3 Cosmitron components.

-In both games, Reset was NOT played.

 

From this, and from the general concensus regarding this game, we can list some likely requirements for the Cosmitron game, in order from most likely to least likely:

-Omnitron-X must be the only incapacitated hero. (All unlockers have confirmed this to be a part of their game.)

-Self Sabotage must be played at least once. (All unlockers have confirmed this to be a part of their game.)

-At least one of each of Omnitron-X's Component cards (Electro-Deployment Unit, Gaussian Coil Blaster, Innervation Ray, Focused Plasma Cannon) must be in his trash before he dies.

-At least one of each of Omnitron-II's Ongoings* (Adaptive Plating Subroutine, Disintegration Beam, Interpolation Beam, Electro-Magnetic Railgun) must be in the villain trash at the end of the game.

-At least one of each of Omnitron-II's Devices* (S-83 Assault Drone, S-84 Automaton Drone, S-85 Repair Drone, Electro-Pulse Explosive) must be in the villain trash at the end of the game.

-At least one of each of Omnitron-II's One-Shots (Terraforming, Technological Singularity, Sedative Flechettes) must be in the villain trash at the end of the game.**

-Omnitron-X must not play Reset.***

 

*The reason I said Ongoings instead of Components is because of a failed Cosmitron game log we have where every single requirement listed above was met EXCEPT for having Adaptive Plating Subroutine in the trash. Mind you, he also didn't have Electro-Pulse Explosive in there, either, but I'm personally not yet sold on needing all the devices or drones in there just yet. Still, to cover my bases, I included it in the list as a possibility.

**Personally I just think it unlikely that villain one-shots are a thing that are needed for this unlock. Still, it happened, so it's in the list.

***I also think it's even less likely they'd restrict us from playing a particular card, but again, covering bases.
